title: 第二十一章 华丽逆袭第二十二章 要挟
slug: 柳无邪和徐凌雪的小说
content_zh:
在所有人的注视下，守在擂台一侧的驯兽师手中飞出去一枚诡异的红色丹药。
毫无征兆！
等到众人反应过来的时候，血纹狮张口将血红色丹药吞下去。
陡然间！
血纹狮气息大变，一滴滴鲜血顺着毛孔溢出，原本淡红色的皮毛，犹如鲜血涂抹的一般，更加妖异。
气势节节攀升，达到二阶妖兽，强横的力量，席卷四野，铁蜈蚣的身体被掀飞出三米多远。
“这是暴妖丹，可以让妖族提升五倍的战斗力。”
众人骇然，暴妖丹极其罕见，每一枚价值连城，达到几十万金币。
万家输不起，必须要拿下这一场胜利。
“作弊，你们作弊！”
松陵站起来，高举双手，发出剧烈的抗议。
没有暴妖丹，血纹狮已经死在擂台上，胜负早已分出。
“作弊，没想到堂堂万家用如此卑劣的手段。”
购买铁蜈蚣赢得武者占据多数，纷纷站起来讨伐，万家触犯了众怒，法不责众，总不能将在场所有人全部诛杀。
“斗兽比赛并无提及不允许使用暴妖丹，这是合理范围之内。”
买血纹狮赢得武者站出来，幸灾乐祸的说道，认为这不算作弊，规则里面并无规定，不允许妖兽使用丹药。
人类战斗，虚弱的时候同样可以使用丹药来补充体力，妖兽也是如此。
双方争论不休，彼此谁也不相让，最后将目光朝柳无邪看过来，他才是最大的输家。
输掉这一场，不仅输掉徐家这座大靠山，还要解除跟徐凌雪的婚约。
“哥，你倒是说句话啊！”

松陵急的团团转，让柳无邪赶紧想办法，他倒好，静静的坐在原地，像是没事人一样。
斗兽场是万家开的，驯兽师是万家的人，柳无邪赢走两场，让万家颜面尽失。
“不急！”
柳无邪睁开双眼，淡淡的说道，说完继续闭上眼睛，不理会四周的吵闹声。
血纹狮开始发狂了，断裂的蹄子感知不到疼痛，疯狂的追逐铁蜈蚣。
面对血纹狮的疯狂撕咬，铁蜈蚣牢牢的龟缩在一起，任由它撕咬，身体早已鲜血淋漓，大片的鳞甲掉下来，场面惨不忍睹。
徐凌雪的心都提到了嗓子眼上，她心里百味陈杂，曾经无数次幻想过，那个人突然有一天会变好，哪怕不能修炼，做一个正常人，她也心满意足了。
从小父母就灌输她一个理念，出生的那一刻起，已经是柳家的媳妇，这个观念从她记事的时候开始，一直陪伴至今。
战况越来越激烈，万卓然坐下来，双拳紧捏，就算赢了这一场，很不光彩，万家的地位，大不如前。
斗兽场的生意，也会逐渐没落，信誉度大大降低。
“撕了他，快上去撕了他。”
田野泉站起来，让血纹狮赶紧上去撕开铁蜈蚣，战斗尽快结束，他恨不能现在就上去扇柳无邪的耳光，只想快点结束比赛。
时间一分一秒的过去，铁蜈蚣迟迟没有死亡，哪怕身体千疮百孔，还能在擂台上继续滚动，伺机寻找机会。
五分钟……
content_en:
Under everyone's gaze, a strange red pill flew out of the hands of the trainer guarding one side of the ring.
No warning!
When everyone reacted, the blood-striped lion opened its mouth and swallowed the blood-red pill.
Suddenly!
The aura of the blood-patterned lion changed drastically, and drops of blood overflowed from its pores. The originally light red fur seemed to be smeared with blood, making it even more monstrous.
The momentum climbed steadily, reaching the second level monster. The tyrannical power swept across the surrounding areas, and the iron centipede's body was lifted more than three meters away.
"This is the violent demon pill, which can increase the combat effectiveness of the demon clan five times."
Everyone was shocked. The Violent Demon Pill was extremely rare, and each one was worth hundreds of thousands of gold coins.
Wanjia cannot afford to lose and must win this victory.
"Cheating, you cheating!"
Song Ling stood up, raised his hands in the air, and protested violently.
Without the Violent Demon Pill, the blood-striped lion would have died in the ring, and the winner would have been decided long ago.
"Cheating, I didn't expect that Dangtang Wanjia would use such despicable means."
The majority of the warriors who bought the iron centipede stood up to attack. The Wan family had offended the public, and the law did not punish the public. It was impossible to kill everyone present.
"The beast fighting competition did not mention that the use of violent demon pills is not allowed. This is within the reasonable range."
The warrior who won the battle by buying the blood-marked lion stood up and gloated, thinking that this was not cheating. There was no provision in the rules that monsters were not allowed to use elixirs.
Humans can also use elixirs to replenish their physical strength when they are weak in battle, and the same goes for monsters.
The two sides argued endlessly, with neither side giving in. Finally, they looked at Liu Wuxie, who was the biggest loser.
If he loses this battle, he will not only lose the Xu family as his great backer, but also dissolve his engagement with Xu Lingxue.
"Brother, you should say something!"
Song Ling was running around anxiously, asking Liu Wuxie to think of a solution quickly, but he just sat there quietly, as if nothing was wrong.
The Colosseum was run by the Wan family, and the animal trainers were from the Wan family. Liu Wuxie won two games, causing the Wan family to lose face.
"No rush!"
Liu Wuxie opened her eyes and said calmly. After speaking, she continued to close her eyes and ignored the noise around her.
The blood-striped lion began to go crazy, feeling no pain from its broken hoof, and chased the iron centipede crazily.
Facing the blood-striped lion's crazy bites, the iron centipede huddled tightly together and allowed it to bite. Its body was already dripping with blood, and large pieces of its scales fell off. The scene was terrible to watch.
Xu Lingxue's heart was in her throat. She had mixed feelings in her heart. She had fantasized countless times that that person would suddenly get better one day. Even if she could not practice cultivation and become a normal person, she would be satisfied.
Her parents have instilled in her the concept that she has been the daughter-in-law of the Liu family from the moment she was born. This concept has been with her since she can remember.
The battle became more and more intense. Wan Zhuoran sat down and clenched his fists. Even if he won this battle, it would be very disgraceful. The Wan family's status was not as good as before.
The Colosseum's business will gradually decline, and its credibility will be greatly reduced.
"Tear him apart, go up and tear him apart."
Tian Tianquan stood up and asked the blood-striped lion to rush up and tear open the iron centipede. The battle would end as soon as possible. He wished he could go up and slap Liu Wuxie now, he just wanted to end the game quickly.
Time passed by, and the iron centipede still did not die. Even though its body was riddled with holes, it could still continue to roll on the ring, waiting for opportunities.
five minutes...
